name: SurviBall
author: Severant
description: This is my project for the mission counting prototype of the pathway "junior programmer",you have to get to the goal 3 times in each map to get 3 stars, this is possible taking advantage of the inertia that you have when you reach the goal, wich is maintained at the restart point, it is a work in progress, so expect for bugs. Enjoy! :)
